statement: The window opens straight into the chamber: the chamber section beside the jet is at least 4.5 times the window area
rationale: The two panel concepts whose window opened into a neck were the quiet, breathy ones: their window paths were 3.7 and 4.3 equal-area radii long, outside every recipe in the acoustics notes (the panel's acoustics review; input vessel-flute-acoustics-notes, section 6, on why low notes in small chambers are breathy). The design spec then asked for at least 250 mm^2 of chamber beside the jet, 4.5 times the window it had; 4.5 is that ratio kept as the limit. It is a design-panel rule with no outside source, and no model here predicts loudness or breathiness (C26 measures the level).

mechanism.how: The area of the rump lobe on the plane across the jet at mid cut-up, integrated by the model, over the window area (cut-up times window height).
